title: teacher-logit-scaling-kd: code, run manifests and pre-declaration records for teacher-side logit scaling in knowledge distillation

description:
Archived snapshot of the analysis code, run manifests, frozen selection audit and dated pre-declaration records behind the study Teacher-Side Logit Scaling Governs Student Calibration in Knowledge Distillation: Dose-Response Evidence from Facial Expression Recognition (under review at Neurocomputing).

The repository is built so that a reader can go from a number printed in the paper to the artifact field that produced it: diagnostics/paper_tables/number_ledger.md binds every printed number to an artifact and a field path, and diagnostics/check_numbers.py re-resolves all of them and exits non-zero on any mismatch. Regenerating the tables needs neither a GPU nor the datasets: pip install -r requirements-level1.txt followed by python diagnostics/paper_tables.py and python diagnostics/table_diff_gate.py, which compares the fresh output against the accepted baseline cell by cell.

What is not here, and why, is stated in the repository's README (section Scope) and in PROVENANCE.md: no dataset is redistributed, no checkpoints, no run directories, and no manuscript source. PROVENANCE.md also carries dated addenda recording where an earlier statement about this archive turned out not to hold.

Pre-declaration records are in Turkish and are included verbatim rather than rewritten; the generated tables and the claim list are in English.

This archive supersedes an earlier one. The same work was first published as FatihSenturk/calibration-law-fer and archived on Zenodo in three versions between 15 and 23 August 2026; all three of those records were withdrawn by the depositor on 25 August 2026, and that repository was made private on 26 August 2026. This is the same work re-published as one clean archive — the same producers, the same measured values and the same dated pre-declaration records. PROVENANCE.md states what is the same and what is not.
